ApprovalAlertContentDef.name: ApprovalAlertContentDef
ApprovalAlertContentDef.description: Represents the mapping that links specific user-created email templates to different notification events such as initial assignment or reassignment within an Advanced Approvals flow.

ApprovalFlowApiName.description: The API name of the approval workflow.

ApprovalStepApiName.description: The unique API name of the approval step.

EmailTemplateId.description: The email template that's associated with an approval step in the approval workflow.

Name.description: The name of the approval alert content definition.

NotificationReason.description: The reason within an approval step's lifecycle that triggers the notification for which an email is sent. For example, when an approval work item is moved from one user to another, a reassignment notification email is sent to the user.
